aka.en: Yinchuan–Wuhan corridor (the western half, as first planned)
aka.zh: 银武通道（最初规划的西半段）
京福高速（福州至南平段原属）

tagline.en: From the Fujian coast to Yinchuan on the Yellow River, by Nanchang, Wuhan and Xi'an
tagline.zh: 自福建沿海经南昌、武汉、西安，直抵黄河畔的银川

start.en: The Zuoqi interchange with G6 at Yinchuan, Ningxia
start.zh: 宁夏银川左旗互通，接 G6 京藏高速

end.en: The Qingkou junction with G15 and the Fuzhou ring, Minhou County, south of Fuzhou
end.zh: 福州南郊闽侯县青口枢纽，接 G15 沈海高速与福州绕城高速

en: G70 runs 2,419 km from Fuzhou to Yinchuan through Fujian, Jiangxi, Hubei, Shaanxi, Gansu and Ningxia, by way of Nanping, Nancheng, Nanchang, De'an, Jiujiang, Huangmei, Huangshi, Wuhan, Xiaogan, Xiangyang, Shiyan, Shangluo, Xi'an, Xianyang, Pingliang, Guyuan, Zhongwei and Wuzhong. By the provincial mileage table in Chinese Wikipedia, Hubei has the most of it — about 770 km, nearly a third — then Ningxia 411, Shaanxi 390, Jiangxi 358, Fujian 346 and Gansu 135.

It climbs from the coast to the loess. Out of Fujian it crosses the Wuyi hills into Jiangxi, runs north from Nanchang past Poyang Lake to the Yangtze at Jiujiang, follows the river to Wuhan, then goes north-west up the Han valley by Xiangyang and Shiyan, over the Qinling into Xi'an, and across the Jing valley and the Liupan Shan to the Yellow River plain at Yinchuan.

Much of it is borrowed road. It shares with G3 out of Fuzhou, with G25 near Shaxian, with G50 from Huangmei to the Baoxie junction east of Wuhan, with the Wuhan ring and G42 north of the city, with G5, G30 and G65 around Xi'an, with G22 between Changqingqiao in Gansu and Baijiagou in Ningxia, and with G6 for most of the way from Zhongwei to Yinchuan.
zh: G70 自福州至银川，全长 2,419 公里，途经福建、江西、湖北、陕西、甘肃、宁夏六省区，经南平、南城、南昌、德安、九江、黄梅、黄石、武汉、孝感、襄阳、十堰、商洛、西安、咸阳、平凉、固原、中卫、吴忠。按维基百科所列分省里程，湖北段最长，约 770 公里，接近三分之一；其次为宁夏 411 公里、陕西 390 公里、江西 358 公里、福建 346 公里、甘肃 135 公里。
这条路从海边一路爬上黄土高原。出福建后翻过武夷山区进入江西，自南昌经鄱阳湖畔北上至九江跨长江，沿江而上到武汉，再向西北溯汉江河谷经襄阳、十堰，翻越秦岭进入西安，然后穿过泾河谷地和六盘山，到达银川所在的黄河平原。
全线有不少路段与其他高速共线：出福州与 G3 京台高速共线，沙县一带与 G25 长深高速共线，黄梅至武汉东面豹澥枢纽与 G50 沪渝高速共线，武汉北面与武汉绕城高速及 G42 沪蓉高速共线，西安一带与 G5、G30、G65 共线，甘肃长庆桥至宁夏白家沟与 G22 青兰高速共线，中卫至银川大部分路段与 G6 京藏高速共线。

en: Its Yangtze crossing is the Jiujiang Yangtze Highway Bridge, the second road bridge at Jiujiang, 10.8 km upstream of the older one. It is a cable-stayed bridge with an 818 m main span — when it opened the seventh-longest of its kind in the world and the fourth in China — 8,462 m long in all, with towers of 242.3 m and 230.9 m, six lanes at 100 km/h and a 100-year design life. The northern tower stands in the river on 43 bored piles, designed to withstand a 3,300-tonne impact; the southern one stands on the levee.

In Shaanxi the road crosses the Qinling on the Lantian–Shangzhou section: 92.79 km with 35 tunnels totalling 37,439 m counted bore by bore, four extra-large bridges and a hundred others. East of Wuhan, between Xishui and Huangshi, it shares the E'dong Yangtze bridge with G50.
zh: G70 跨长江靠的是九江长江公路大桥，即九江长江二桥，位于原九江长江大桥上游 10.8 公里。主桥为斜拉桥，主跨 818 米，建成时居世界同类桥梁第七、国内第四；桥梁全长 8,462 米，北、南主塔高 242.3 米和 230.9 米，双向六车道，设计时速 100 公里，设计使用寿命 100 年。北主塔立于江中，桥墩由 43 根钻孔灌注桩组成，设计防撞能力 3,300 吨；南主塔建在长江大堤上。
陕西境内，蓝田至商州段翻越秦岭：全长 92.79 公里，隧道 35 座、单洞合计 37,439 米，特大桥 4 座，大中桥 100 座。武汉以东浠水与黄石之间，G70 与 G50 共用鄂东长江大桥。

en: The western half began as a western development corridor. In 2000 the Ministry of Communications named eight inter-provincial routes for the western regions, among them Yinchuan to Wuhan by way of Xi'an. The 2005 national expressway plan extended it to the Fujian coast as G70. Its Fuzhou–Nanping stretch had been built as part of the Beijing–Fuzhou expressway; it stopped carrying G3 in 2014, when the Fuzhou ring opened and G3 got its own line.

Hubei, with the longest share, built the Wuhan–Shiyan road in pieces. Shiyan's city government, judging a 400 km scheme too large to be approved at once, submitted the first 28 km, Wudangshan to Xujiapeng, separately, with the estimate held under a billion yuan and a promise of local matching funds; it was approved in August 1999 and begun on 26 December 1999, the first mountain expressway in Hubei. Xiangyang–Shiyan was finished on 26 December 2003, and on 30 September 2005 the Xiaogan–Xiangyang section completed the 400-odd km from Wuhan. Shiyan to the Shaanxi border at Manchuanguan followed on 31 December 2007, and in Shaanxi the Lantian–Shangzhou road opened in October 2008.

The last gaps were in the north-west and on the Yangtze. Encyclopaedia and trade-press accounts put the end of construction in Ningxia in November 2011 and the last 13.2 km in Gansu, near Changqingqiao, on 22 December 2011. Until 28 October 2013, though, northbound traffic still crossed the Yangtze on the old Jiujiang bridge and had to use National Highway 105 through Xiaochi to rejoin the expressway; the new bridge, begun on 27 September 2009, removed that bottleneck.
zh: 西半段起源于西部开发通道。2000 年交通部提出八条西部省际公路通道，其中一条是银川经西安至武汉。2005 年国家高速公路网规划将其向东延伸至福建沿海，编号 G70。福州至南平段原为京福高速的一部分；2014 年福州绕城高速通车、G3 京台高速另有线位之后，这一段不再与 G3 共线。

里程最长的湖北段分段修建。十堰市考虑到 400 多公里一次报批投资过大、难以通过，先将武当山至许家棚 28 公里单独上报，投资概算压在 10 亿元以内，并承诺地方配套资金，1999 年 8 月获批，同年 12 月 26 日开工，为湖北首条山区高速公路。襄十段于 2003 年 12 月 26 日全线竣工；2005 年 9 月 30 日孝襄段通车，武汉至十堰 400 多公里全线贯通。十堰至陕西界漫川关段于 2007 年 12 月 31 日通车；陕西蓝商段于 2008 年 10 月通车。
最后的缺口在西北和长江上。据百科和行业媒体资料，宁夏境内于 2011 年 11 月贯通，甘肃长庆桥一带最后 13.2 公里于 2011 年 12 月 22 日通车。但直到 2013 年 10 月 28 日之前，北上车辆仍须走老九江长江大桥过江，再借道 105 国道经小池重上高速；2009 年 9 月 27 日开工的九江长江公路大桥建成后，这一瓶颈才告消除。

en: No cost for the whole road has been published. Xinhua put the Wuhan–Shiyan road at more than 13 billion yuan when it was completed in 2005; it was the second expressway in Hubei, after the province's part of the Beijing–Zhuhai, to be built with World Bank loans, US$250 million for the Xiaogan–Xiangyang section alone. The Jiujiang Yangtze Highway Bridge project, 25.2 km with its approaches, cost about 4.478 billion yuan, shared by the two provinces: Jiangxi paid for the bridge and the south approach, estimated at 3.761 billion, and Hubei for the 8.19 km north approach.
zh: 全线没有公布过总造价。2005 年汉十高速全线贯通时，新华社报道其投资总额 130 多亿元；它是继京珠高速湖北段之后，湖北又一条利用世界银行贷款修建的高速公路，仅孝襄段就利用世界银行贷款 2.5 亿美元。九江长江公路大桥项目连同引道全长 25.2 公里，总投资约 44.78 亿元，由赣鄂两省共同投资：跨江大桥和南岸引道由江西投资建设，概算 37.61 亿元；北岸引道 8.19 公里由湖北投资建设。

en: The new Jiujiang bridge took about half an hour off the drive from Nanchang to Wuhan or Hefei, by Jiangxi Expressway Group's reckoning. Looking back on the finishing of Xiangyang–Shiyan in 2003, Shiyan Evening News wrote that a return trip to Wuhan could now be made in a day, about four hours each way.
zh: 据江西高速集团介绍，九江长江公路大桥通车后，从南昌到武汉、合肥可省半小时左右车程。《十堰晚报》回顾 2003 年襄十高速竣工时写道，十堰市民往返武汉可以一天一个来回，单程约 4 个小时。

why.en: No total has been published. Six provinces and regions financed their own sections between 1999 and 2013; the sourced section costs are given separately below.
why.zh: 全线总造价未见公布。沿线六省区在 1999 至 2013 年间分别为境内路段筹资；已查到出处的路段造价另列如下。

timeline.en: Work begins on 26 December on Wudangshan–Xujiapeng, the first piece of the Wuhan–Shiyan road and Hubei's first mountain expressway.
timeline.zh: 12 月 26 日，武当山至许家棚段开工，为汉十高速第一段，也是湖北首条山区高速公路。

timeline.en: Yinchuan–Wuhan is named one of eight western inter-provincial corridors.
timeline.zh: 银川至武汉被列为八条西部省际通道之一。
12 月 26 日，襄十高速全线竣工。

timeline.en: Xiaogan–Xiangyang opens on 30 September, completing Wuhan–Shiyan.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日孝襄高速通车，汉十高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: Shiyan–Manchuanguan, to the Shaanxi border, opens on 31 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 31 日，十漫高速通车，接至陕西界。

timeline.en: The Lantian–Shangzhou road over the Qinling opens in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，翻越秦岭的蓝商高速通车。

timeline.en: Work on the Jiujiang Yangtze Highway Bridge begins on 27 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 27 日，九江长江公路大桥开工。

timeline.en: The last sections in Ningxia and Gansu open, the Gansu one on 22 December (trade-press and encyclopaedia accounts).
timeline.zh: 宁夏、甘肃最后路段通车，甘肃段于 12 月 22 日（据行业媒体及百科资料）。

timeline.en: The Jiujiang Yangtze Highway Bridge opens on 28 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 28 日，九江长江公路大桥建成通车。

timeline.en: The Fuzhou ring opens and G3 no longer runs over G70 out of Fuzhou.
timeline.zh: 福州绕城高速通车，G3 京台高速不再借用福银高速出福州。
